jobs.title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Kaishi is currently with a fast growing AI-focused start-up building enterprise software for regulated industries, including banking, financial services and insurance.
  
  
What they do
  
  
The firm build AI-powered tools that support customer-facing teams through training, real-time assistance and automated workflows. Their enterprise clients operate across markets and languages. Key engineering challenges include latency, reliability, testing non-deterministic systems, meeting stringent security requirements and delivering natural multilingual AI interactions.
  
  
Why this role exists
  
  
The business has expanded from an initial product to multiple products serving enterprise clients. Much of this growth has relied on client-specific implementations. Shared capabilities such as tenant configuration, identity, model access and evaluation now exist in several versions, increasing the engineering effort required for each new client.
  
  
**We want a common platform:** shared services, configuration per client instead of code per client, and eventually a builder that lets us assemble new use cases. You would own the platform core, extract shared capabilities while products continue shipping, and set the technical bar for a distributed engineering team. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with weekly coding responsibilities, rather than a management or advisory-only architecture position.
  
  
What you would do
  
  

* Build shared capabilities for configuration, identity and permissions, tenant isolation, model and retrieval access, and evaluation.
* Extract these capabilities from existing products without stopping delivery, and drive adoption across multiple teams.
* Make architecture and migration decisions across repositories, from design through production operation.
* Set and uphold standards for ownership, review, testing, security and release, while helping teams deliver under pressure.
* Provide safe ways to vary behaviour per client without client-specific forks or hard-coded conditions.
* Work with infrastructure engineers on deployment, CI/CD and observability.
* Ensure every important system has a second owner, including the systems you build.

First three months
  
  
**Month one:** Get to know the codebase and platform work already under way; agree the migration sequence with technical leads; become second owner of one critical system.
  
  
**Month two:** Extract the first shared capability and run it in production for one product, with tests, an owner and an adoption plan for the next product.
  
  
**Month three:** Have a second product adopting the capability or migrating; document and agree the next two quarters of platform work; establish a named second owner for what you have built.
  
  
What we need from you
  
  

* 8 or more years building production backend systems, with Staff-level experience: architecture across several teams, end-to-end migrations, and adoption driven in teams that did not report to you.
* Deep production experience with TypeScript and Node.js. Comfortable working in Python and reviewing code outside your main language.
* Practical multi-tenant SaaS experience: designing, testing and operating controls that prevent one client’s data from reaching another.
* Experience decomposing a monolith or extracting shared services while keeping it in production, with clear examples of sequencing, trade-offs and lessons learned.
* Infrastructure judgment covering Kubernetes, GCP or AWS, CI/CD and observability. You can design for and review these systems, even if you do not operate them directly.
* Strong security and data-handling instincts, ideally gained in a regulated environment.
* Clear written communication for a distributed team working across time zones.
* Ability to push back on unsafe shortcuts under pressure while maintaining trust.

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience in banking, insurance or another regulated industry, including security reviews, SOC 2 or Singapore’s OSPAR.
* LLM application experience: model gateways, retrieval, prompt versioning, evaluation harnesses and testing non-deterministic output.
* Experience with internal developer platforms or self-service configuration systems.
* Practical use of AI coding tools and sound judgment about their benefits, limitations and review requirements.

Kaishi Partners (EA No. 16C8316) was set up to meet the recruitment demands of the fast growing South-East Asia technology community - an expansion led by the Singapore government’s ‘Smart Nation’ vision.
  
  
Our clients span from cutting edge start-ups to global brand names; venture capital to innovation labs; e-commerce platforms to fintech disruptors.
  
  
If you’re a company anywhere on the spectrum from seed to IPO, or a candidate looking to play your role in making Singapore the next Silicon Valley, then Kaishi are the partner to advise you.

jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

  

**How you'll make an impact**
-----------------------------

Growth Engineering at Airwallex is building an AI-native platform that powers customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion. We're developing scalable infrastructure, intelligent decision systems, and high-performance web experiences that connect product, sales, and marketing to drive measurable business outcomes.

As an **Engineering Lead, Full Stack,** you'll lead a team of engineers to design, build, and scale the web experiences and growth platforms that power Airwallex's customer acquisition and conversion journeys. You'll own the technical direction and execution of customer-facing web applications, corporate websites, content management systems, and growth capabilities, combining strong full-stack engineering expertise with technical leadership and product judgment.

* **Partner across functions**, working closely with Product, Design, Marketing, Data Science, and other engineering teams to translate ambiguous business needs into intuitive experiences and scalable technical solutions.
* **Drive measurable business outcomes**, using performance metrics, experimentation, and customer insights to improve website performance, conversion, engagement, and overall growth effectiveness.
* **Raise the engineering bar**, establishing strong engineering practices for code quality, web performance, accessibility, SEO, security, reliability, observability, and operational excellence.

SG: You'll work from our Singapore office five days a week.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

**Essentials**
--------------

* **8+ years of professional software engineering experience**, including experience leading engineers or complex technical initiatives, and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* **Strong full-stack engineering expertise**, with hands-on experience building and operating production web applications using modern frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript, alongside backend technologies such as Python, Java/Kotlin, or Node.js.
* **Demonstrated ownership of web engineering**, with experience architecting, building, and scaling customer-facing websites, web applications, CMS platforms, landing pages, or similar digital experiences, including integrations with backend services and third-party systems.
* **Proven technical leadership and execution skills**, with a track record of leading complex engineering initiatives, making sound architectural decisions, navigating technical tradeoffs, and delivering high-quality solutions end to end.
* **Strong product judgment, ownership, and people leadership**, with the ability to mentor and develop engineers, work effectively with Product, Design, and Marketing, navigate ambiguity, and translate business goals into measurable engineering outcomes.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience building or owning growth-oriented web platforms, including corporate websites, headless CMS, landing page platforms, marketing websites, or self-service product experiences.
* Experience with growth systems and conversion optimization, including experimentation platforms, A/B testing, personalization, SEO, web analytics, attribution, or marketing technology integrations.
* Experience designing and scaling modern web architectures, including server-side rendering, static site generation, CDN/edge infrastructure, caching, and web performance optimization.
* Experience building AI-powered applications or agentic workflows, including LLM integration, tool orchestration, evaluation, and production observability.
* Experience leading cross-functional engineering initiatives involving Product, Design, Marketing, Data Science, or Revenue Operations.
* Experience in high-growth technology companies, fintech, payments, or regulated environments.

**You'll thrive here if**
-------------------------

* **You have high agency and ownership.** You proactively identify opportunities, take accountability for outcomes, and empower your team to deliver.
* **You're a hands-on full-stack technical leader.** You're equally comfortable discussing frontend architecture, backend services, web performance, and end-to-end system design, and you stay close enough to implementation to guide critical technical decisions.
* **You care about the intersection of engineering, user experience, and growth.** You understand that fast, reliable, intuitive web experiences directly influence acquisition, engagement, and conversion.
* **You're pragmatic and outcome-oriented.** You balance engineering quality, delivery speed, and business impact, prioritizing solutions that deliver meaningful customer and business value.
* **You're comfortable leading through ambiguity.** You bring structure to complex problems, establish clear priorities, and make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information.
* **You grow people and teams.** You coach engineers, delegate effectively, create clarity, and build a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* **You communicate proactively and influence effectively.** You align stakeholders, surface risks early, navigate tradeoffs, and drive decisions across functions.
* **You thrive in a global environment.** You're comfortable leading and collaborating across distributed teams in APAC, EMEA, and the US.

**Learn more about your team**
------------------------------

Growth at Airwallex is building a unified, AI-native growth system across product, sales, and marketing. Rather than applying AI to isolated tasks, we use customer context, machine learning, automation, and continuous learning to transform how Airwallex acquires, activates, converts, retains, and expands customers.

You’ll build high-traffic platforms, experimentation frameworks, and intelligent decision systems that turn signals—such as company profile, product usage, lifecycle stage, behavior, and intent—into personalized journeys, next-best actions, and measurable incremental value.

The work spans both human + AI and autonomous operating models: AI-native tools that increase the leverage of growth teams, alongside agentic workflows that can research opportunities, launch and optimize campaigns, orchestrate customer journeys, and measure outcomes within clear strategies and guardrails.

The challenge is to combine consumer-technology speed with the precision, trust, and regulatory complexity of global B2B finance. If you enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, prototyping quickly, measuring real business impact, and using every outcome to improve the next decision, you’ll help define how an AI-native global financial platform grows.

**2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year**

Risk.net

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

**The Role**

We're looking for a C++ Software Engineer who wants to build low-latency trading infrastructure on Linux. You'll work on the core components of our Switchboard trading platform — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

**What You'll Work On**

* Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source
* Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres
* Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging
* Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes
* FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers
* Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible
* Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

**What We Need**

**Technical:**

* Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (3+ years)
* Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code
* Experience with performance-sensitive systems (profiling, optimisation, deterministic behaviour)
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, socket programming)
* Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly
* Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows
* Git and shell scripting
* Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

**How you work:**

* **You ship.**
  You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production
* **You own it.**
  When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop
* **You write things down.**
  Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist
* **You communicate.**
  We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential
* **You care about quality.**
  You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating
* **You embrace AI tooling.**
  We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

**What You Get**

* **Real problems**
  —
  trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks
* **An excellent team**
  — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards
* **Ownership**
  — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients
* **Competitive package**
  — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites
* **Remote-friendly**
  — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver
* **Sustainable pace**
  — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp
* **Growth**
  — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.
